notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - 15th of September 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Change Log[/h1]

Settings UI has now been updated with several tabs to make room for future QoL and features

From our internal testing this version and onwards should have a lot better performance as a result of the new AI system being used to drive enemies.

Enemies now use Unity NavMesh and crowds seem to be more performant than before as well as more natural in their movement.

Equipment Drop Rate has been halved to make better space for future content and replayability, we found that games would progress way too fast and might adjust this up or down depending, in the future.

Fixed a CPU performance issue with UI auto navigation for gamepads/keyboard navigation for when no visible navigable UI was on screen.

.MP3 soundtracks have been replaced with remastered .WAV soundtracks for better audio quality

Difficulty select now defaults to the first option

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - 7th of August 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Change Log[/h1]

Added new graphics for Ascension paths
Added 3 new Steam Achievements related to Ascension
Added better zoom functionality to ascension UI for both Gamepad and Mouse & Keyboard

Area stat now specifies its metric unit
Reduced Icicle particles significantly

Fixed jittery player health bar movement

Selectable UI elements now scale down slightly when selected in order to help with color blindness visibility

[h1]Ascension Achievement Issues[/h1]
If you enter ascension screen with 1, 5 or 15 soul shards which are the achievement requirements and don't get the achievements, you will have to edit your profile to allow the game to re-check:
Go through:
Settings -> Browse Data Folder
Close the Game to ensure that you are allowed to make changes.
Then in the opened file explorer go to:
Profiles > Whatever Profile ID you have -> Campaigns
Then open the most recent Campaign.xml file in a text editor

Go down to the Achievements section where you will find something similar to:

    <Achievement Id="2/27" Unlocked="true" />
    <Achievement Id="2/28" Unlocked="true" />
    <Achievement Id="2/29" Unlocked="true" />

For only these 3 achievements (look at the "Id" per line to compare), replace their "true" with "false" like so:

    <Achievement Id="2/27" Unlocked="false" />
    <Achievement Id="2/28" Unlocked="false" />
    <Achievement Id="2/29" Unlocked="false" />

It's very important that you make NO OTHER CHANGES to this file otherwise it might fail to load.

If you have issues with this still after all that, feel free to hop in our discord :) (join button can be found in the game's menu or on our store page)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - 29th of July 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Ascension Tier 1 - The Cardinal Sins[/h1]

Ascension Tier 1 is finally here! Level up permanently between matches and obtain Soul Shards which can be used for powerful upgrades!

5 Soul Shards are required in order to access the Ascension system which opens up the door for 15 powerful upgrades which push you through a few of the higher difficulties.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/bkdb8bv.jpeg][img]https://i.imgur.com/bkdb8bv.jpeg[/img][/url]

You can choose only 3 paths in this system all of which gives a unique Pickup ability per path which alters game play and build types significantly.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/uY756Au.gif][img]https://i.imgur.com/uY756Au.gif[/img][/url]

Each path is assigned an Element which will be useful for Tier 2 of Ascension which we will release at a later stage.

[url=https://i.imgur.com/0ji5cRn.gif][img]https://i.imgur.com/0ji5cRn.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Change Log[/h1]

Our extended trailer theme now plays in the credits view

Camera Movement is now always centered on the player
Previously this would lag behind by quite a bit and the faster movement speed you had, the worse it got.
We're still taking feedback on this on our discord or our steam discussions, but we feel that this makes for more responsive gameplay currently.

Camera Zoom is now slightly further away from the game world

Game Summary now has experience and level animations as well as audio
Game Summary laughter/mockery audio now plays after experience gain and global level up audio
Game summary now uses comma separation in big numbers
Game Summary now shows Time alive as X day(s) hours, minutes and seconds instead of total seconds

Added Ascension path elements to stat summary in-game
Added Ascension unique unlocks to stat summary in-game
Added Ascension stats to stat summary as a separate category
Ascension paths can now easily be re-configured at no respec cost
Ascension now has a Stat Summary for currently selected nodes
Ascension max chosen paths is now 3
Ascension now has an information button which explains the concept
Ascension nodes will now automatically move the camera/zoom if navigated through other means than mouse

[h1]Pickup Changes[/h1]
Added Healing Pickup which doubles healing received
Added Thorns Pickup which deals 1000% of your Armor to attackers as Damage
Breakable Spawn Rates have been increased by 40% to make all breakables remain at their old spawn rates
Pickups affected by Ascension Unique Unlock traits now have different colors

Double Damage Pickup will now be colored more red while Havoc is active
Double Damage now deals Quadruple Damage while Havoc is active

Double Healing Pickup will now be colored red while Embrace or Feast is active
Double Healing Pickup now heals 4x while Embrace is active

Double Healing Pickup now doubles health regeneration speed while Feast is active

Double Experience Pickup now gives Quadruple Experience if Avarice is active
Double Experience Pickup Icon is now more red while Avarice is active

Magnet Pickup now lasts twice as long while Avarice is active
MagnetPickup Icon is now more red while Avarice is active

Slow Time Pickup now lasts 50% longer while Grudge is active
Slow Time Pickup icon is now colored red while Grudge is active

Thorns Pickup icon is now more red while Backlash is active
Thorns Pickup now deals 10000% Armor as damage to attackers while Backlash is active
Thorns Pickup lasts twice as long while Backlash is active

Power of the True God icon is now more red while Vampirism is active
Power of the True God will now life steal 50% of all damage dealt while Vampirism is active

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - 13th of July 2023
notes.content:
[h1]UI & QoL[/h1]

Added music volume slider

Screen mode can now be changed in settings

Experience and Soul bonus from Prey is now displayed in-game


[h1]Balance[/h1]
In-game soul and experience prey bonuses now show time based prey

Time based prey now gives xp and soul bonuses

[h1]Gamepad & Input[/h1]
Gamepad and Keyboard & Mouse will now automatically be detected based on previous input method

Fixed an issue where UI elements displaying control inputs would not show correctly for gamepads in all situations

Look direction is now same as movement direction on gamepads if aim stick is not being used

Added ControlDisplay for Equipment Encyclopedia

Enemy Encyclopedia in-game display now toggles together with inventory

[h1]Bugs & Fixes[/h1]
Increased sparks starting Area from 2 -> 4 to deal with hit test issues

Prestige 0 / 20 will now show correctly in enemy encyclopedia

In-game Prey multiplier display no longer shows as percentage but “X” instead

Using portals is no longer possible while the game is paused

Increased max spawn amount in Void Portal to avoid an exploit which skipped 300 mobs

Difficulty selection number localization fixed from “1,0X” → “1.0X”

Luck stat description now correctly describes what Luck does, it used to erroneously state that it gave soul and experience gains.
